builder.template_desc.armored_truck_esco: Escort a cash truck along a route and fight off ambushes.
builder.template_desc.beat_patrol: Drive a set of checkpoints and hold in each one for a few seconds.
builder.template_desc.bomb_disposal: Search a building, find every device and defuse it in time.
builder.template_desc.business_check: Check the doors of businesses on the beat and log each result.
builder.template_desc.gang_shootout: Clear an armed gang out of a hideout and secure the scene.
builder.template_desc.hostage_rescue: Neutralise the robbers, free the hostages and walk them out.
builder.template_desc.manhunt: Use clues to shrink a search circle, then catch the fugitives alive.
builder.template_desc.parking_patrol: Inspect parked cars, run the plates and cite or tow the right ones.
builder.template_desc.pursuit_sim: Follow a fleeing car along a route without touching it.
builder.template_desc.warrant_service: Knock and announce, arrest the suspect and search the property.
